kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From North Levantine Arabic مِنْحِبَّك (minḥibbak, “we love you”) + ـجِيّ (-jiyy). It was coined by protesters to Bashar al-Assad.
s: North Levantine Arabic مِنْحِبَّك (minḥibbak, “we love you”) + ـجِيّ (-jiyy)
g: someone perceived to be a supporter of an existing authoritarian regime; a loyalist

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: مِنْحِبَّكْجِيّ • (minḥibbakjiyy) (feminine مِنْحِبَّكْجِيَّة (minḥibbakjiyya), masculine plural مِنْحِبَّكْجِيُّون (minḥibbakjiyyūn), feminine plural مِنْحِبَّكْجِيَّات (minḥibbakjiyyāt))
